decisions.D1: head clock; body & ethanol interp onto it; clean both first
decisions.D2: translation-invariant kinematic: phi=atan2(head-body) unwrapped deg; omega=|dphi/dt| deg/s smoothed; NOT v_nose/v_com
decisions.D4: head cast within pause: cumulative |dphi| >= 40 deg AND peak omega >= omega_min(90th pct=156.6)
decisions.D5: bout = pause with >=1 cast; merge onsets < t_merge=0.50s; onset=pause start; peak=max omega time
decisions.D6: RARITY GATE: pooled median rate << 1.7/s, target 0.05-0.3/s; tighten if >0.5/s. PROBED median 0.007/s -> PASSES at defaults; keep defaults
decisions.D7: incidental = high-omega events while moving (v_com>=v_pause); contrast class
decisions.D8: baseline-sub ethanol = raw - rolling 10th-pct W=20s -> head clock, raw scale
decisions.D9: odor-reached = Plume odor_fields.h5 valid bin (count>=3) with max>0.001; in-odor at bout onset; fallback r=100px
decisions.D10: unit=trial; trial-level Wilcoxon/bootstrap 2000 seed 1234; NEVER point-bootstrap; only >=1-bout trials for bout tests; pooled Loc1-6; anotherLoc separate
decisions.D11: onset-aligned H1/H2; peak-omega-aligned kinematics; peri +-1s 50ms; pre-onset [-0.75,-0.25]s; peri-odor [-0.5,+0.5]s
decisions.D12: Fig3 example = trial with most bouts (rate within gate)

deliverable_A.rarity: median rate + count dist + %trials>=1 vs v1 1.7/s
deliverable_A.selectivity: bouts vs incidental: v_com (bouts<<incidental, DEFINITIONAL), excursion/peak omega (bouts>=incidental)
deliverable_A.sanity: example trial bouts coincide with visible head casts during pauses

H1.test: peri-bout eth [-0.5,+0.5]s vs matched random-time null (trial Wilcoxon); AND bouts>incidental
H1.amplitude_check: peri eth vs 0.14 & 4e-4; frac bouts peri>0.01

H2.test: pre-onset [-0.75,-0.25]s eth > baseline/null; onset-aligned slope [-1,0]s>0; controls: incidental + odor-reached-vs-absent
H2.accept: pre>baseline/null AND slope>0 AND survives controls

H3.test: f_bout vs f_occ + within-trial permutation null (2000); trial Wilcoxon f_bout>f_occ & f_bout-null>0

reports: reports/H3 - sampling bouts in odor-reached regions.docx

acceptance.gate1: accessor-only; advancing-ref clean ~0.5%; head-clock interp; translation-invariant kinematic (no v_com denominator); D6 gate passes (median rate<<1.7/s) final params; rates alongside counts; trial-level inference only; >=3 numbers/deliverable re-derived; seed; zero placeholders
acceptance.gate2: events rare & not denominator-biased (low-COM definitional); rarity gate satisfied; amplitude check before odor claims; magnitude+trial-CIs not N-driven p; H2 precedence non-circular + controls; kinematic spot-check; direction before significance; honest nulls
